law_record.title: Standing or parking on one-way roadway
law_record.text: If a laned roadway is restricted to one direction, a person shall not stand or park a vehicle upon the left-hand side of such one-way roadway unless official traffic-control devices are erected permitting such standing or parking.

activation_conditions: the roadway is laned and restricted to one direction

exceptions: where official traffic-control devices are erected permitting such standing or parking
